description: Home beauty-device brand founded in 2013, best known for its IPL hair-removal devices; its own affiliate page describes it as the #1 global IPL device in sales, trusted by 7M+ users worldwide, with over 4 million units sold in 17 countries.

evidence.summary: Ulike's own affiliate page invites affiliates, agencies, content creators and individuals to promote its IPL devices: up to 20% commission per sale, 30-day cookie, completely free to join, applications reviewed within 2-3 business days, and certified affiliates receive free products for review. The page publishes affiliate@ulike.com for program questions and states top affiliates earn $15,000 each month.

Ulike's Awin merchant profile lists premium commissions of 8%-20% per sale plus performance bonuses, consistent with the brand page's up-to-20% figure; the recorded rate is the 20% top of that published range. No earnings-cap statement appears on either page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The brand page describes Ulike as the '#1 global IPL device in sales' trusted by 7M+ users worldwide; its page details state the company was founded in 2013 and has sold over 4 million units in 17 countries.

name: Ulike

reasons.compensation: Published range of 8%-20% per sale via Awin with the brand page confirming up to 20% and a 30-day cookie; no cap statement found, so the cap stays unknown.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate email (affiliate@ulike.com) is published on the program page, plus an open application.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2013; claims #1 global IPL device sales and 7M+ users on its own program page.
reasons.niche_fit: IPL hair-removal devices are a core beauty-creator niche with heavy TikTok/UGC demand.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free online application on the brand's own page, reviewed within 2-3 business days.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own page explicitly recruits content creators and gives certified affiliates free products for review.

description: Direct-to-consumer beauty brand founded in 2019 by Kasey Jackson and her husband Tim, selling DIY under-lash extension clusters designed for at-home application beneath the natural lashes.

evidence.summary: FlutterHabit's own collab page runs three creator routes: Flutter Bestie Ambassadors (creators with 1K+ followers; free products bi-monthly and content featured on brand socials), Flutter Sweetheart Affiliates (15% commission on every sale through a personal link or code, plus regular product restocks), and a Campus Club with commission opportunities. The page prints the brand's address: 7811 Lemona Ave, Van Nuys, California 91405.

LinkClicky's directory (last updated March 10, 2024) lists a separate FlutterHabit program on Impact at 5% per sale and 5% per recurring subscription. That conflicts with the 15% published on the brand's current own page, so no single commission rate is recorded.

Sovrn Commerce's merchant profile describes FlutterHabit as a direct-to-consumer beauty brand founded in 2019 by Kasey Jackson and her husband Tim Jackson, specializing in DIY false-lash clusters designed for application beneath the natural lashes.

name: FlutterHabit

opportunity.title: Flutter Sweetheart Affiliates & Flutter Bestie Ambassador Program

reasons.compensation: The brand's own page publishes 15% commission for Sweetheart Affiliates, but a directory listing for its Impact program says 5% — conflicting, so the rate is null and compensation is scored mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: Public application routes (Typeform/Workable) for each program on the official page; no public email found.
reasons.credibility: DTC brand founded in 2019 with a published US business address in Van Nuys, California.
reasons.niche_fit: DIY lash clusters are a highly demonstrable, creator-led beauty niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are publicly open, including to creators with as few as 1K followers for the ambassador tier.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Three structured creator programs on the brand's own page, with ambassador content featured across the brand's social platforms.

name: Skin Virtue
